items.title: Bennedict Mathurin's contract came in a bit lower than originally reported:
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Bennedict Mathurin's contract came in a bit lower than originally reported:

2026-27: $7.5M
2027-28: $7.8M - Player Option

Pelicans have $7.5M of the Non-Taxpayer MLE remaining. New Orleans is $4M from the luxury tax with 15 players on standard contracts.

items.title: Pelicans have officially acquired Bennedict Mathurin
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Pelicans have officially acquired Bennedict Mathurin

Joe Dumars statement!

“We are thrilled to welcome Bennedict to New Orleans. He embodies the toughness and competitiveness we want our team to play with every night, and his mental and physical approach aligns with the culture we are building.”
